+# Fixture ticket: critic reviews a small diff
+
+This fixture represents the critic role reviewing a small diff during a
+`/gauntlet` run. The scope stays within an existing top-level directory
+(`tasks/`), so it does not trip any EGM trigger and the critic can start
+without waiting on EGM approval.
+
+Router instrumentation counts the tokens for the diff text under both the
+routed path (workhorse model) and the direct-premium path.
